Commit the VERIFYING timeout fix if it is ready.

Then immediately return to the highest-priority production work:

1. Complete owner authentication.
2. Complete registration for every member role.
3. Complete email verification and password recovery.
4. Complete payment integration (Stripe and bank transfers).
5. Complete investment transaction workflow.
6. Complete admin synchronization across app, landing page, reels, and deal pages.
7. Verify every API, route, database table, and production endpoint with real evidence.

Do not declare VERIFIED until each feature is tested end-to-end in production.
